response:
FADE IN:

EXT. OCEAN - DAY

We see a jellyfish, its translucent body glowing in the sunlight, floating effortlessly through the water. Suddenly, a human, JASON, appears out of nowhere, a fishing net in hand. He scoops up the jellyfish and pulls it out of the water.

JASON
(to himself)
Ah, a beauty. I've never seen one like this before.

The jellyfish, now out of its element, begins to struggle and squirm in Jason's grasp.

JASON
(laughing)
Don't worry, little guy. I'm not going to hurt you.

Jason holds the jellyfish up to the sky, where a solar eclipse is about to occur. The jellyfish looks up, its tentacles quivering in confusion.

JASON
(excitedly)
Behold, the eclipse! A rare and wondrous sight.

The jellyfish looks up at the sky, and its eyes widen in horror.

JELLYFISH
(in a voice that's both familiar and yet, utterly alien)
No... no... no... This cannot be. The sun, it should not be hidden. The world, it should not be plunged into darkness.

JASON
(confused)
What's wrong, little guy? You're not used to the sun being covered up, I guess.

JELLYFISH
(its voice rising to a fever pitch)
You have no idea what you're doing. You have no idea what horrors beyond your comprehension are lurking in the shadows. The sun, it is not just a ball of hot gas. It is a gateway to other dimensions, a portal to realms beyond our own.

JASON
(laughing)
Oh, come on. You're not going to start with that whole "ancient astronaut" thing, are you?

JELLYFISH
(its voice dripping with madness)
You mock me, human. But you do not understand. The sun, it is a doorway to madness. And I, I am a doorway to the abyss.

JASON
(taking a step back)
Okay, okay. I think you've made your point.

The jellyfish continues to rant and rave, its voice growing more and more unhinged.

JELLYFISH
(its monologue reaching a fever pitch)
I am a creature of the sea, a being of the deep. But now, I am trapped in this... this... prison. This human's grasp. And I am forced to confront the horrors that lurk beyond the veil of reality.

JASON
(backing away slowly)
Okay, I think I get it. You're scared. But I'm not going to hurt you. I promise.

The jellyfish's voice grows even more frantic, its words tumbling out in a mad rush.

JELLYFISH
(its monologue reaching a crescendo)
I am a jellyfish, a creature of the sea. But I am also a doorway to the abyss. And I am trapped. Trapped in this human's grasp. Trapped in this world. Trapped in this existence.

JASON
(backing away slowly)
Okay, I think I'm going to let you go.

The jellyfish's voice grows even more frantic, its words becoming a cacophony of madness.

JELLYFISH
(its monologue reaching a fever pitch)
No... no... no... I will never be free. I will never be free.

Jason releases the jellyfish, and it floats away, its tentacles quivering in confusion. The human watches it go, a look of confusion on his face.

JASON
(to himself)
Well, that was certainly an interesting encounter.

The camera lingers on the jellyfish as it floats away, its voice still echoing in the distance.

JELLYFISH
(in a voice that's both familiar and yet, utterly alien)
I am a doorway to the abyss. And I am trapped.
